report:
Liver, segment 2 nodule, biopsy

Sections show a core of liver measuring 15 mm in length. The core contains a hepatocellular lesion composed of benign hepatocytes in plates one to two cells thick, with fibrous septa containing thick-walled vessels, ductular reaction and inflammation, and no normal portal tracts. Glutamine synthetase shows a map-like pattern. The reticulin framework is retained. The background liver shows no significant abnormality.

LIVER, segment 2 nodule, biopsy - FOCAL NODULAR HYPERPLASIA
